defaults.description: Applied to every sample below. Exactly equivalent to writing each key on every sample entry; a sample that states the key wins.

mapper.description: Mapper to use. Only "alevin" is implemented end-to-end; "kb" and "starsolo" are gated at startup.

mapping_config.description: Profile under mappers.<mapper> in mapping_config.yaml. Selects the index; this is how a second species is wired in.

index_ref.description: Optional. Names an entry in index_config.yaml directly, bypassing the mapper profile. For one-offs that do not warrant their own profile.

sample_type.description: Drives the ambiguous-read fallback in preprocess.py and sample-type-keyed thresholds in filter_config.yaml.

prep.description: Protoplasting protocol. Two values: "1h_2h_mix" (a 1 h + 2 h protoplast mix) and "2h_only". Corrected 2026-08-01 -- the old "1h_post_protoplasting"/"standard" vocabulary was wrong in both directions: it implied SMu005/006/008 differed from the rest of the SMu series (they do not -- ALL EIGHT SMu samples are 1h_2h_mix), and "standard" hid that BDMock/BDNod are the minority protocol within BD. Every 10x protoplast sample and both BD tip samples are 2h_only. Legal as a batch_key only where it is CROSSED with condition, which inside BD it now is (mock and NF each appear at both levels) but only because SMu005/006/008 are in `induced_bd` -- with the 7-sample group it was a perfect proxy for rhizobia-vs-control and correcting on it would have deleted the infection axis. Omit where a cohort has only one variant.

treatment.description: Experimental treatment applied, as a value rather than a substring of `batch`: mock, NF, BAP, S_meliloti, none. Stamped onto .obs so results can be grouped by it. NEVER a batch_key -- correcting on it deletes the effect being measured, and validate.py errors.

time_h.description: Hours since treatment applied. NF/BAP at 3 hpt and S. meliloti at 12-96 hpi share this numeric axis while being different timelines, so it is interpretable only together with `treatment` -- never order cells on time_h across treatments. Omitted entirely on untreated samples. Mock is 0 by convention; under the staggered-inoculation / common-harvest design it was harvested alongside every timepoint and is a control for all of them, not a t=0 baseline. NEVER a batch_key.

fallback.description: NOT READ BY ANY CODE PATH. The ambiguous-read fallback chain (per-cell, per-gene, global, sample_type) is hardcoded in preprocess.py and keyed off sample_type. Retained because it is written on every sample; safe to delete.

qc_metrics.description: Profile under QCconfigs in qc_config.yaml. Defaults to "default".

batch.description: Batch label carried into integration. Falls back to the sample name.

fastq2.description: R2 FASTQ paths; must be the same length as fastq1.

samples.description: Mapping of sample name to sample entry.

additionalProperties.description: One sample. Any key omitted here falls back to the sheet-level `defaults:` block.
